system.description:
You pour mana into form and shape it into an extension of your own body, whether it be a golem, a clone of one of your body parts or your Soul Armament. Once it takes form, you can act with it immediately before it dissipates.

You make two attacks, each dealing damage equal to [Arcana + 3]. If all attacks hit the same target, they are Dropped.

Elemental Spark Effects:

  • Fire: Increase the damage dealt to [2 x Arcana] and make a third attack.
  • Water: If your first attack hits, the target is Soaked. If both attacks hit, the target becomes Frozen instead.
  • Earth: If both attacks hit the target, they are also Stunned.
  • Air: If your first attack hits, the target is Shocked. If both attacks hit, the target is pushed back 3 Spaces.
